keyEvents.text: Goal! Toluca 1, Atlas 0. Helinho (Toluca) left footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Nicolás Castro.
Alexis Vega (Toluca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Florián Monzón (Atlas).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Toluca 1, Atlas 0.
Substitution, Toluca. Everardo López replaces Jesús Angulo.
Delay in match because of an injury Paulinho (Toluca).
Delay in match (Atlas).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Toluca 2, Atlas 0. Helinho (Toluca) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Milton Valenzuela (Atlas).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Atlas. Jorge Rodríguez replaces Milton Valenzuela because of an injury.
Substitution, Atlas. Arturo González replaces Édgar Zaldívar.
Substitution, Atlas. Ryan Mmaee replaces Florián Monzón.
Substitution, Toluca. Fernando Arce replaces Paulinho.
Substitution, Toluca. Federico Viñas replaces Alexis Vega.
Substitution, Toluca. Jorge Díaz replaces Helinho.
Substitution, Atlas. Víctor Ríos replaces Aldo Rocha.
Substitution, Atlas. Rivaldo Lozano replaces Luís Esteves.
Delay in match because of an injury Luis García (Toluca).
Substitution, Toluca. Antonio Briseño replaces Luan.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Antonio Briseño (Toluca) is shown the yellow card.
Ryan Mmaee (Atlas) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Manuel Capasso (Atlas).
Delay in match because of an injury Luis García (Toluca).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second Half ends, Toluca 2, Atlas 0.
